meta.name: article-magazine
meta.description: Substack / Medium 高级感长文排版, 适合公众号、博客发布

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将文章排版成高级感长文，适合公众号和博客发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将文章排版成Substack或Medium风格的高级感长文
copy.tagline_en: Format articles into premium long-form layouts for WeChat and blogs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to format articles into premium long-form layouts like Substack or Medium

howto.what: 用户要求排版长文时，Claude 会生成杂志式 HTML：顶部大标题与作者/阅读时间元数据，正文单栏居中约700px宽，标题用衬线字体，引用、代码块、列表均有专门样式，章节间用装饰线分隔，文末附转发卡片。
howto.when: 当用户要求把文章排版成 Substack/Medium 风格，或要求生成适合公众号、博客发布的长文版式时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这篇文章排版成杂志风格
say.note: 会生成带完整样式的 HTML 页面

say.text: 用 Substack 风格美化这篇长文
say.note: 正文和标题会有对比排版

say.text: 把这个博客文章做成高级感版式

howto.what_en: When asked to format a long article, Claude produces a magazine-style HTML layout: a hero header with title and metadata, a single centered column of about 700px, serif headings, styled quotes/code/lists, ornamental section dividers, and a share call-to-action at the end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to format an article in Substack/Medium style, or to generate a long-form layout suitable for WeChat official accounts or blogs.

say_en.text: Please format this article in magazine style.
say_en.note: Generates a fully styled HTML page.

say_en.text: Beautify this long read with a Substack look.
say_en.note: Adds visual contrast between body and headings.

say_en.text: Turn this blog post into a premium layout.
say_en.note: Includes a share card at the end.
